checks.name: page elements exist and initial state is clean
first click arms destructive button, displays non-overlapping prompt, and second click confirms
keyboard activation displays press prompt, and Escape cancels confirmation and still reaches the page
clicking outside an armed button cancels pending confirmation
accessibility: visible focus indicator is unobscured, prompt has >= 4.5:1 contrast, and button meets 24x24 target size
harmless buttons, card links with buried action words, and non-destructive controls are left alone
